results.title: Budget Policy Statement
results.description: A citizen-friendly guide to Kenya's Budget Policy Statement 2026, prepared under the guidance of Millicent Makina, Board Advisor at Budget Ndio Story.

steps.title: Understanding the BPS
steps.text: The Budget Policy Statement (BPS) is Kenya's early roadmap for the national budget. It sets priorities, spending ceilings, and policy signals before the full estimates are published.
